goal_intent: book a quiet table for two and warn that you may arrive late

turns.utterance: Hello there, I’m calling to book a table for a nice quiet dinner, if that’s possible.
Thank you very much, that’s very kind. It will just be two of us for dinner, so a table for two, please.
Thank you for asking. I’d like to book it for Monday, if that’s available. Monday for two, please.
Thank you for checking. We’d like the table at 6pm, if that’s all right. So, Monday at 6pm for two people.
Thank you so much, I appreciate it. My name is Edward Naylor—that’s Edward, E-D-W-A-R-D, and Naylor, N-A-Y-L-O-R.

Thank you, that’s wonderful. Just one small thing—I may be about ten minutes late, as the bus can be a bit unreliable, so if you could make a note of that, I’d be very grateful. Thank you for your patience.
Thank you ever so much for your help and kindness, that’s very reassuring. I look forward to Monday evening. Wishing you a pleasant night as well. [END OF CALL]
